'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Catatumbo campaign]]
***[[2025 Catatumbo attacks]]
****Fourteen members of the 33rd Front of [[FARC dissidents]], including one minor, surrender to personnel from the [[National Army of Colombia]] to avoid combat with the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|ELN]]. [https://www.bluradio.com/nacion/14-disidentes-de-las-farc-se-entregaron-en-medio-de-guerra-contra-eln-en-catatumbo-rg10 (''Blu Radio'')]
****The [[Office of the Inspector General of Colombia]] warns that about 46,000 schoolchildren have not been able to start the [[academic year]] due to the ongoing conflict in the region and asserted that about 35% of the affected displaced population are individuals under the age of 18. [https://www.elespectador.com/judicial/alrededor-de-46000-ninos-se-quedaron-sin-ir-a-clase-en-el-catatumbo/ (''El Espectador'')]
*[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank (2023–present)|Israeli incursions in the West Bank]]
**[[2025 Israeli raid on Jenin]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] launch [[2025 Israeli raid on Jenin|a large-scale raid]] in the [[Jenin refugee camp]], in the [[Israeli-occupied territories|Israeli-occupied]] [[West Bank]], killing at least ten people and injuring more than 35 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/21/israeli-army-launches-deadly-attack-on-jenin-refugee-camp-in-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels seize the town of [[Minova]] in [[Kalehe Territory]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], cutting off a major supply route to the strategic city of [[Goma]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congos-m23-rebels-seize-eastern-town-minova-2025-01-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Former regional prosecutor of [[Cuautitlán]] Elohim Díaz Jiménez and coffee businessman Cristian Muñoz are shot dead inside a restaurant in [[Metepec]], [[State of Mexico]], by gunmen disguised as food delivery workers. [https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/exfiscal-regional-de-cuautitlan-es-asesinado-en-metepec/ (El Universal)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Six people are killed in [[Homs Governorate]], [[Syria]], as [[Syrian Armed Forces|security forces]] conduct an operation against militias supporting ousted [[President of Syria|president]] [[Bashar al-Assad]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/01/21/six-killed-as-syria-security-forces-launch-sweep-in-homs-province (Al Arabiya)]
*Four people are injured, one seriously, in a [[Mass stabbing|stabbing attack]] in [[Tel Aviv]], [[Israel]]. The [[Shin Bet]] confirm that the attacker was a 28-year-old from [[Morocco]], and had [[permanent residency]] in the [[Green card|United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp8qv8gz1m3o (BBC)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/one-seriously-wounded-in-suspected-tel-aviv-stabbing-attack-medics/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://english.news.cn/20250122/ba124e01edd14f35a96912817adf637a/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Infrastructure policy of Donald Trump]]
**[[Stargate LLC|The Stargate Project]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] unveils a [[joint venture]] between [[OpenAI]], [[Oracle Corporation|Oracle]], and [[SoftBank Group|SoftBank]], called Stargate. With planned funding of up to $500 billion in the next four years, the project aims to build [[data center]]s and [[computing infrastructure]] across the [[United States]] to power AI development and create over 100,000 jobs. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2025/jan/22/trump-ai-investment-tech-ceos (''The Guardian'')]
**President Trump announces a pause in $300 billion of funding for [[green infrastructure]] previously allocated in the [[Inflation Reduction Act]] and [[Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/fcaf50dc-6779-44d2-a7fa-264df798a4c1 (''Financial Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 California wildfires]]
**[[January 2025 Southern California wildfires]]
***Multiple [[Wildfire|brush fires]] spread by [[Hurricane force wind warning|hurricane-force winds]] erupt in [[San Diego County, California|San Diego County]], [[California]], U.S., prompting evacuation orders. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2025/01/21/california-wildfires-san-diego-los-angeles/77844651007/ (USA Today)]
*[[2024–2025 floods in Southeast Asia and South Asia]]
**Sixteen people are killed in [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s in [[Central Java Province]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/landslides-flash-floods-indonesias-java-island-leave-16-117929532 (ABC)]
*[[2025 Kartalkaya hotel fire]]
**At least 76 people are killed and another 51 injured in a fire at the Grand Kartal hotel in [[Kartalkaya]], [[Bolu Province]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/six-dead-31-injured-ski-resort-hotel-fire-turkey-state-broadcaster-says-2025-01-21/ (Reuters)]
*Seventeen people are killed and 23 more injured after a collision between a bus and a truck in Ponan-Ouinlo, [[Ivory Coast]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ivory-coast-crash-ponan-ouinlo-f357f4bff556a9802c21834f005e5363 (AP)]
*Much of [[Canada]] and the contiguous [[United States]] are impacted by a [[cold wave]], killing one person near [[Milwaukee]], [[Wisconsin]]. Historic snowfall is expected in the [[southern United States|US South]], and historic [[blizzard]] and [[whiteout (weather)|whiteout conditions]] are expected on the [[Gulf Coast of the United States|Gulf Coast]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/21/weather/winter-storm-south-tuesday-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*One person is killed and another is injured in an explosion at the [[Port of Barcelona]] in [[Barcelona]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/blast-spains-barcelona-port-kills-one-person-emergency-services-say-2025-01-21/ (Reuters)]
*Twenty [[Ethiopians|Ethiopian]] migrants are killed when their boat capsizes off [[Yemen]] after departing from [[Djibouti]], according to the [[International Organization for Migration]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/01/21/boat-capsized-off-yemen-killing-20-ethiopian-migrants-iom-says (Al Arabiya)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Afghanistan–United States relations]]
**Two [[Americans]] held in [[Afghanistan]] are [[prisoner swap|freed in exchange]] for a [[Taliban]] fighter in the [[United States]]. The deal is brokered by [[Qatar]] and finalized during the final hours of the outgoing [[Biden administration]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/taliban-say-2-americans-released-in-prisoner-swap/a-71357642 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Pope Francis]] announces that nun [[Raffaella Petrini]] will be appointed [[Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State|President of the Governorate]], becoming the first woman head of government of Vatican City. She will assume the office on March 2025. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/261691/italian-nun-raffaella-petrini-to-head-vatican-governorate (''Catholic News Agency'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] pardons [[Ross Ulbricht]], the creator of the [[Silk Road (marketplace)|Silk Road]]. Ulbricht was serving a [[life sentence]] for charges including conspiracy to commit [[money laundering]], [[Security hacker|hacking]], and [[drug trafficking]]. [https://www.axios.com/2025/01/22/trump-ross-ulbricht-silk-road (Axios)]
